message: Record with non-null value for AETERM where AESPID is missing
ai_root_cause: AESPID not populated for all AE records — likely missing from source data mapping
ai_suggested_fix: Populate AESPID from source CRF field SPONSOR_AE_ID. Review mapping spec section 3.2.

message: Value of RFSTDTC is after RFENDTC
ai_root_cause: Reference start date populated after end date — likely data entry error or imputation logic issue
ai_suggested_fix: Review RFSTDTC/RFENDTC derivation. Cross-check with VISITDTC for Visit 1.

message: TRTSDT is missing for subjects with ITTFL=Y
ai_root_cause: Treatment start date missing for ITT subjects — ADSL derivation logic not handling screen-failure edge case
ai_suggested_fix: Add condition: if ITTFL=Y and TRTSDT is null, derive from EX.EXSTDTC first non-missing.

message: More than 20% of records have LBORRES missing where LBSTAT is null
ai_root_cause: Lab results missing without corresponding NOT DONE flag — source EDC data issue
ai_suggested_fix: Set LBSTAT=ND and LBREASND=NOT DONE for records where LBORRES is null and LBSTAT is null.

message: CMDOSE is non-null but CMDOSU is missing
ai_root_cause: Dose recorded without unit — mapping spec missing CMDOSU derivation
ai_suggested_fix: Add CMDOSU derivation from CRF DOSE_UNIT field. Default to mg if unit field is blank and drug route is oral.

message: ASTDT is missing for 12 records in ADAE
ai_root_cause: Adverse event analysis start date not derived — AESTDTC has partial dates not handled by conversion macro
ai_suggested_fix: Update %ISO8601_TO_NUM macro to handle partial dates: use first of month if day missing.

message: VSSTRESU values inconsistent: mix of 'mmHg' and 'mm Hg' for blood pressure
ai_root_cause: Unit values not standardized — source EDC allows free-text entry for units
ai_suggested_fix: Standardize in mapping: VSSTRESU = 'mmHg' for all blood pressure records. Add to standardization macro.

message: BASE is populated for subjects where ABLFL is null
ai_root_cause: Baseline flag not set correctly — multiple pre-dose records exist and selection logic defaulting to wrong visit
ai_suggested_fix: Review ABLFL derivation: baseline = last non-missing result before first dose (TRTSDT). Check ADLB_baseline_criteria in SAP.

ai_root_cause: Zero dose recorded when exposure occurred — likely data cleaning gap in EDC
ai_suggested_fix: Escalate to DM for source data query. If dose actually administered, obtain correct value. If not, set EXOCCUR=N.

message: AGE not consistent with BRTHDTC and RFSTDTC for 3 subjects
ai_root_cause: Age derived from rounded year only — not using full date calculation
ai_suggested_fix: Re-derive AGE = floor((RFSTDTC_date - BRTHDTC_date)/365.25). Update DM derivation program.

message: LBTEST label in Define.xml does not match codelist in SDTM IG v3.4
ai_root_cause: Codelist in Define.xml references old version of LBTEST codelist
ai_suggested_fix: Update Define.xml LBTEST codelist to CDISC LBTEST v3.4. Re-run define generation program.

message: CMROUTE codelist not referenced in Define.xml ItemDef
ai_root_cause: CMROUTE added to SDTM but Define.xml not regenerated after SAP amendment
ai_suggested_fix: Regenerate Define.xml from updated metadata. Verify CMROUTE codelist C66729 is referenced.

message: EVNTDESC is null for 5 records where CNSR=0
ai_root_cause: Event description missing for uncensored TTE records — derivation not handling composite endpoint correctly
ai_suggested_fix: Populate EVNTDESC for all CNSR=0 records. Source from first qualifying event in AE/DS per SAP section 9.3.

message: MHENRTPT='BEFORE' for records where MHTERM is an ongoing condition
ai_root_cause: Ongoing medical history coded as ended — MHENRTPT should be 'ONGOING' for active conditions
ai_suggested_fix: Review MH mapping: set MHENRTPT=ONGOING where MHONGO=Y in source data.

message: SAFFL=Y for 2 subjects with no EX records
ai_root_cause: Safety population flag incorrectly set — subjects without any drug exposure flagged as safety
ai_suggested_fix: Safety population requires at least one EX record (EXOCCUR=Y). Remove SAFFL=Y for subjects with no EX records.
